business_summary: Elanco Animal Health Incorporated, an animal health company, innovates, develops, manufactures, and markets products for pets and farm animals worldwide. The company offers pet health products, such as parasiticides, vaccines, and therapeutics that protect pets from fleas, ticks, and internal parasites under the Seresto, K-9 Advantage, Advantix, and Advocate trademarks; prescription parasiticide products, an over-the-counter treatments for the prevention and elimination of fleas and ticks under the Credelio Family, Interceptor Plus, Drontal family, and Drontal Plus; vaccines portfolio that provides differentiated prevention coverage for a number of important pet health risks; and therapeutics portfolio for the treatment of pain, otitis, cardiovascular, and dermatology indications, as well as osteoarthritis for dogs and cats under the Galliprant trademark. It also provides farm animal products that help farmers improve animal health and wellbeing, and raise livestock, such as cattle, swine, and poultry. In addition, the company offers medicated feed additives, injectable antibiotics, vaccines, insecticides and enzymes, and others under the Rumensin, Baytril, and Experior trademarks for cattle; and under the Maxiban and Monteban trademarks for the control and prevention of intestinal disease in poultry. Further, it offers other pet health products for cats and dogs under the Atopica, Milbemax, Onsior, and Tru Family trademarks; and other farm animal products for poultry, cattle, and swine under the AviPro, Catosal, Denagard, Hemicell, Pulmotil, and Surmax tradmarks. The company sells its products to third-party distributors and independent retailers; and directly to farm animal producers and veterinarians. Elanco Animal Health Incorporated was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana.
business_summary_ko: 동물 건강 회사인 Elanco Animal Health Incorporated는 전 세계적으로 애완동물과 농장 동물을 위한 제품을 혁신, 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 Seresto, K-9 Advantage, Advantix 및 Advocate 상표로 벼룩, 진드기 및 내부 기생충으로부터 애완동물을 보호하는 구충제, 백신 및 치료제와 같은 애완동물 건강 제품을 제공합니다. Credelio 제품군, Interceptor Plus, Drontal 제품군 및 Drontal Plus에 따라 벼룩 및 진드기 예방 및 제거를 위한 일반의약품인 구충제 처방 제품; 다양한 중요한 애완동물 건강 위험에 대해 차별화된 예방 보장을 제공하는 백신 포트폴리오; Galliprant 상표로 개와 고양이를 위한 통증, 중이염, 심혈관 및 피부과 적응증뿐만 아니라 골관절염 치료를 위한 치료 포트폴리오도 있습니다. 또한 농부들이 동물의 건강과 복지를 개선하고 소, 돼지, 가금류와 같은 가축을 사육하는 데 도움이 되는 농장 동물 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 Rumensin, Baytril 및 Experior 상표로 약용 사료 첨가제, 주사 가능한 항생제, 백신, 살충제 및 효소 등을 제공합니다.
